thread:
mei: Quick sync 17: PR is ready to land for the SDK snippets reorg and migration guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2499. We need this merged before the docs cutoff (Mon Jul 14 23:59 PDT). Main concerns: preview build, redirects for old snippet URLs, and ensuring the change only appears in the v2025-07 versioned sidebar until the FF is ramped.

jon: Thanks Mei. I'll review the snippets and run the sample commands. Do we have a migration blurb for release notes?

mei: Added a 3-line migration note in the PR: "Config rename: `sdk.batch_mode` -> `sdk.batch.strategy`. Old key honored behind FF `ff.sdk.batch.v2` for 14 days." Also included a small sed helper in the PR description.

rachel: Preview bot shows an asset 404: `Missing /static/images/snippet-flow-v2.png`. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4022. I can re-upload the image if needed.

mei: I must have missed that when renaming directories. Uploading now and pushing a path fix. Can someone trigger a rebuild?

ci-bot: preview: rebuild queued by @rachel. Current status: running.

jon: Two review items: 1) please keep the top-level unversioned nav unchanged (we should only add the new entries to `versions/v2025-07/sidebars.json`). 2) add a 301 redirect from `/sdk/snippets` -> `/versioned/v2025-07/sdk/snippets_v2` so external links continue working.

mei: Done on both counts: updated versions-sidebar and added `_redirects` entry. Also fixed the image path.

ci-bot: preview: success. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-2499--redwood-docs.netlify.app. All checks passed.

rachel: Reviewed and approved. Left one tiny nit about a code fence language label. Mei, can you squash into a single commit and rebase onto main for a clean merge?

mei: Squashed and rebased. Pushed.

jon: From release side: propose merge Thu Jul 10 09:00 PDT to allow four days of canary monitoring before cutoff. That gives SRE time to watch link metrics and any snippet embed regressions. Any objections?

rachel: No objections. I'll monitor staging for missing assets and verify redirects after prod deploy.

mei: Thanks team. After merge I will: 1) post a short migration note to #support, 2) open a backfill PR for the SDK-examples repo, and 3) add the change to the release notes under "Docs migrations."

ci-bot: merged: PR2499 merged into main at 1971234620. Staging deploy started.

jon: :white_check_mark: I'll watch canary dashboards and ping here if anything spikes.
